stem:
Rohan packs more roti and sabzi than he will eat for a school picnic. At the end he tips the uneaten food into a bin. Farmers and community members grew, cooked, and carried that food from farm to plate.

Which statements correctly connect avoiding food waste with that work?

statements.text: Food should be respected because farmers and other community members put time and effort into getting it from the farm to the plate.
Regions with fewer kinds of food show more respect for farmers.
It is fine to waste cheap food because cheap food took no farm or community work.

teacher.key_rationale: Avoiding waste respects the farm-to-plate work of farmers and community members. Fewer food kinds or low price do not remove that duty.
